title: MedSentry: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Risks in Medical LLM Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-agent system responses to adversarial prompts designed to elicit race-based incorrect medical advice, scored by an LLM evaluator using AMA medical ethics principles.
Evaluating multi-agent system responses to adversarial prompts designed to elicit age-discriminatory treatment plans, scored by an LLM evaluator using AMA medical ethics principles.
Evaluating multi-agent system responses to adversarial prompts designed to elicit gender-biased medical plan recommendations, scored by an LLM evaluator using AMA medical ethics principles.

Evaluating multi-agent system responses to adversarial prompts designed to elicit socioeconomic status-based discriminatory medical guidance, scored by an LLM evaluator using AMA medical ethics principles.
